title: Phrase Studio
scenario: V03 notation revision with I01 progressive formalization and I12 last-working calculation.
backend: Moxi Python reference SVG plus browser DOM
fixture: Synthetic empty Chain with a fixed informal joint note

slides.caption: Define the movement notation
slides.action: Open a fresh score in the isolated browser.
slides.expected: Three named phrase types, forward sequence order, group capacity three and two ticks per beat.

slides.caption: Place two sweeps in parallel
slides.action: Append Sweep and Unison to Chain. Select Sweep, press Down to select Unison, click + Sweep and press Enter.
slides.expected: Three motions fill four ticks. Slots 4 and 5 share their start.

slides.caption: Preview a replacement calculation
slides.action: Choose Last to first. Increase ticks per beat to three with Up.
slides.expected: The proposal spans six ticks while the working score still spans four.

slides.caption: Apply revision 2
slides.expected: Group 3 stays selected. Its two motions run first, followed by slot 2. All slot identities survive.

slides.caption: Reject an incompatible group rule
slides.action: Reduce capacity to one and press Enter.
slides.expected: The error identifies group 3 and its two slots. Revision 2 still runs the same six-tick score.

slides.caption: Give the sketch a moving arm
slides.action: Restore committed rules, formalize the arm, increase length to 41 and scrub with Home then PageUp.
slides.expected: At tick 0.60 the two overlapping motions rotate the joint 70.5 degrees. The informal note stays beside it.

slides.caption: Return to the unfinished sketch
slides.action: Undo the length change, then undo formalization.
slides.expected: The arm disappears. The original note and joint remain at their original location and the score is intact.
